offering_description.value: GCI Liberty provides internet, wireless, voice and managed network services to households, businesses and public institutions in Alaska. It delivers these services through fiber, cable, wireless and satellite networks.

primary_services.value: fixed broadband; mobile wireless; enterprise and wholesale data connectivity; managed network services; voice service

customer_segment.value: B2C: households and individual wireless subscribers; B2B: businesses, telecom carriers, private schools and healthcare providers; B2G: government agencies, public school districts and public libraries

end_markets.value: residential communications; commercial enterprise; healthcare; education; government

revenue_model.value: subscription: monthly internet, mobile and voice plans; project or contract: dedicated connectivity and managed networks for enterprises, institutions and carriers; product sales: mobile phones and accessories; other: universal service support for rural network coverage
revenue_model.category: subscription; project or contract; product sales; other

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: runs fiber, cable and wireless infrastructure to connect households, institutions and carriers; service provider: combines network capacity and technical support to deliver managed connectivity to businesses and public institutions; retailer: sells third-party phones and accessories to wireless customers

geography_served.value: US regional: Alaska, including remote rural communities

specialization.value: related lines: fixed broadband, wireless, voice and managed networking

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: enterprise, institutional and wholesale account teams; own locations: company-operated retail stores in Alaska; online: company website for shopping plans and devices

regulatory_exposure.value: high: FCC spectrum licensing and universal service rules, plus Alaska utility oversight for regulated voice services

notes: Current availability of retail television service is uncertain.
divestiture_lines: P2.19: Liberty Broadband Corporation and GCI Liberty, Inc. completes the spin-off of GCI Liberty from Liberty Broadband.
